The Implicit KD-Tree for Iso-Surface Ray Tracing was introduced by Wald et al. in 2005 [WFM*05].
It builds on the concept of min/max kd-trees for coherent iso-surface ray tracing, aiming to reduce the memory overhead of traditional kd-tree implementations.
